source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Document all of the brake test results from the prior six months.
3. Read the results of the current brake test up and down the columns.
4. Enter the results of the current brake test in the column on the right hand side of the page.
5. Read the failure message of the current brake test, if applicable.
6. Mark the applicable failure box.
7. If an alternate clearance is considered, check the box and enter the actual clearance.
8. Use red ink and circle the lowest clearance in a column with which a test result does not agree.
9. Mark out an obvious error in the records and use the clearance column to record a new value. Do not cross out a test result to
    change it if no error has been discovered. This would constitute falsifying the inspection report.
10. Document the actual clearance corresponding to the current brake test result being questioned.
